row.answer: Zilean is a support mage who uses bombs for area damage and stuns, changes movement speed, and protects allies with revival. Rewind helps him reuse his basic abilities; his bomb damage scales with AP.
row.counterplay: Spread away from bomb carriers, watch for follow-up bombs, and consider switching targets while revival protection is active.

citations.quote: Innate: Zilean generates a storage of experience over time. When he has enough to level up an allied champion, he can channel by selecting them to split the stored experience between himself and the ally.
A successful channel will grant an equal amount of experience to the ally for them to level up as well as to Zilean, with a combined minimum of 15% of the stored experience.
